title: Historic Filipinotown Comes Alive
description:
Historic Filipinotown came together at Unidad Park to celebrate community, culture, and connection at the one-year anniversary of the Kanto Corner HiFi Fall Fest.

Held quarterly in Los Angeles’ Historic Filipinotown, Kanto Corner brings neighbors together to celebrate Filipino heritage, support local businesses, and strengthen community ties amid concerns about displacement and gentrification.

Mutual aid was at the heart of the Fall Fest, with organizers partnering with neighborhood markets to distribute fresh groceries and connecting residents with health providers for free on-site services.

What started as a neighborhood gathering has grown into a welcoming space where immigrant families and longtime residents can connect, access resources, and celebrate the community they call home.

Following its spring and summer events, Kanto Corner returns to Historic Filipinotown this December for Winter Fest.
